subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e compreender, com certa autonomia, narrativas ficcionais que apresentem cenários e personagens, observando os elementos da estrutura narrativa: enredo, tempo, espaço, personagens, narrador e a construção do discurso indireto e discurso direto.

components.description_pt: Demonstrar compreensão de detalhes-chave respondendo perguntas sobre personagens e eventos
components.description_en: Demonstrate understanding of key details by responding to questions about characters, setting, and events
components.cc_component_description: Demonstrate understanding of key details by responding to questions about characters, setting, and events

components.description_pt: Analisar elementos de estrutura narrativa: enredo, tempo, espaço, personagens e narrador
components.description_en: Analyze the elements of narrative structure: plot, time, setting, characters, and narrator
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a theme develops through characters, setting, and plot over the course of a text

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre discurso direto e discurso indireto em narrativas ficcionais
components.description_en: Distinguish between direct speech and indirect speech in fictional narratives
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between paraphrasing and direct quotation when restating information from diverse formats

components.description_pt: Explicar como elementos narrativos contribuem para construção de significado em história
components.description_en: Explain how narrative elements contribute to the construction of meaning in a story
components.cc_component_description: Explain how structural features of a text contribute to a reader's understanding of its content

cc_matches.description: Ask and answer such questions as who, what, where, when, why, and how to demonstrate understanding of key details in a text.

Determine a theme or central idea of a text and analyze its development over the course of the text, including its relationship to the characters, setting, and plot; provide an objective summary of the text.
Paraphrase portions of a text read aloud or information presented in diverse media and formats, including visually, quantitatively, and orally.
Describe the overall structure (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution) of events, ideas, concepts, or information in a text or part of a text.
